The '''Welcome Hall''' was a place in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rhol Yan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalimahr/Legends|Kalimahr]]. It was located in the port tower of the city. It was a large room with lines of interview pods. One entire side was a [[Window/Legends|window]] offering staggering views across Rhol Yan and the [[Southern Ocean (Kalimahr)|sea]] beyond, and the opposite wall was covered with an artwork that labelled the place the Welcome Hall. One had to take three [[Turbolift|elevators]] in order to reach the ground level of the tower from there. In [[25,793 BBY]], the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] visited Kalimahr to meet with [[Tre Sana]]. She faced an interview from three [[Officer/Legends|officers]], and with a subtle use of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and a gentle word, she passed through the security check.<ref name="Into the Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Welcome Hall first appeared in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]'', a [[2013]] novel written by [[Tim Lebbon]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
